plugins.name: delegate-kit
plugins.description: 7 specialist subagents (director, thinker, super-thinker, researcher, executer, simple-tasks, bug-hunter) + the /subagents playbook for when to use each. The director is the orchestrator: hand it an objective with /delegate-kit:run and it spawns the rest of the fleet, with no file access of its own. Run /delegate-kit:setup to compose them for your machine — works on built-ins alone, and wires in Serena, graphify, the Python defect taxonomy, or your own integrations when you have them.
